title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Service Guarantee: Fee Returned for Late Dispensing
content:
## Pharmacy service guarantee: share of the fee by length of delay

**Guarantee.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy expedited order the pharmacy dispensed late, the share of the booked fee returned depends on the dispensing delay: for a delay of one or two business days it is figured per day, a quarter of the fee for each business day of delay; for a delay of three or four business days it is a flat three quarters; and for a delay of five business days or more it is all of the fee.

The dispensing delay is the number of business days (Monday through Friday) from the order date to the ship date, counting the ship date and not the order date, less the processing promise: the program's new-prescription processing business days for an order placed for a new prescription, and the program's refill processing business days for any other order. The order date is the date on the placed order; the ship date is the date on the order's shipment record.

### Share by delay

| Dispensing delay (business days) | Share of the booked fee returned |
|---|---|
| 1 | a quarter (0.25) |
| 2 | a quarter for each day, one half |
| 3 or 4 | a flat three quarters (0.75) |
| 5 or more | all of the fee |

### Counting business days (hypothetical orders)

| Order date | Ship date | Business days counted | Promise | Delay | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | following Monday | Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Mon: 5 | refill, 2 days | 3 | three quarters |
| Friday | following Wednesday | Mon, Tue, Wed: 3 | refill, 1 day | 2 | one half |
| Monday | Friday of the following week | 9 | new prescription, 4 days | 5 | all of the fee |
| Wednesday | following Monday | Thu, Fri, Mon: 3 | refill, 2 days | 1 | a quarter |

Saturdays and Sundays are never counted, and the order date itself is never counted.
